items.title: Iran says it has agreed Strait of Hormuz shipping route with Oman
items.description: A foreign ministry spokesman did not give details but said an agreement with the Gulf nation was "in the final stages".

items.title: After deadly Kyiv strike, Ukraine warns interceptor shortage is costing lives
items.description: Without Patriot interceptors, Ukraine's skies are wide open and people are fully exposed to Russia's missile barrages.

items.title: Drone carrying explosives found at German airport, police say
items.description: The drone was found near Ukrainian cargo planes before another object collided with a cargo aircraft in mid-air.

items.title: Israel strikes south Lebanon after first evacuation warning in weeks
items.description: Lebanon's health ministry says one person was killed in the strikes, which the Israeli military says were a response to a Hezbollah ceasefire violation.

items.title: Fifa admits mistakes but Infantino remains president
items.description: Gianni Infantino will remain as Fifa president after he receives the backing of senior executives following a meeting, despite the governing body admitting "mistakes" were made.

items.title: Why some scientists are thrilled that a SpaceX rocket has crashed into the Moon
items.description: While the collision was an accident, it is a unique scientific gift for planetary geologists that could provide important data for future space missions.

items.title: Waste workers help winner find binned €1m lottery ticket in Italy
items.description: The player only realised they binned the life-changing ticket after family told them the numbers he played for years had been drawn.

items.title: Ex-leader Hasina gambles on return to Bangladesh despite death penalty
items.description: The 78-year-old has been convicted of crimes against humanity over a deadly crackdown on a 2024 uprising.

items.title: Youth protests have weakened Modi, Indian activist who went on hunger strike tells BBC
items.description: The "cockroach" movement was one of the biggest public displays of dissent against India's prime minister in years.

items.title: UN rights chief alarmed by rise in Iran executions since March
items.description: Volker Türk says 56 people have been executed on national security-related charges, including 27 in cases linked to January's protests.

items.title: South Africa plans new rules on ex-leaders' foreign trips after Zuma's visit to India
items.description: Jacob Zuma was pictured with a businessmen allegedly at the heart of a corruption scandal in South Africa

items.title: Mexican influencer shot dead during livestream
items.description: César Gastélum, who was known for comedy and lifestyle posts, was killed at close range by a man on a motorbike.
